path.description: Workspace-relative folder or file to migrate. Only files under it are written.
path.x-prompt: Which folder or file should be migrated (workspace-relative, for example src/app/billing)?

project.description: Project the path belongs to. The path may then also be given relative to the project's sourceRoot, and a path outside the project is refused.

report.description: Workspace-relative path of the Markdown report. A JSON twin with the same name and the extension .json is written next to it.

rules.description: Comma-separated subset of the rules to run: icon, button, tooltip, spinner, chip, imports.

printReport.description: Print the full Markdown report to the console. Default: only in a dry run, where no file is written.
